title: Maxwell: A new kind of model that sits between code and hardware
summary: Maxwell is a revolutionary 'Code Execution Model' that sits between code and hardware, automatically optimizing program execution in real-time without changing any code. It analyzes traces, profiling data, and runtime information to dynamically adapt to the hardware environment and input characteristics.
problem_solved: Automatically optimizes code performance at runtime without requiring developers to modify their code or manually tune performance.
why_valuable: Enables transparent, continuous performance optimization that adapts to hardware and runtime conditions without any developer intervention or code changes.
